info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Card By Param1-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Retrieval API allows users to fetch specific credit card details using a unique parameter identifier. This endpoint is designed for applications that require retrieval of card information for user verification, account management, or transaction processing. Typical consumers include banking applications and financial service providers that need to display or verify credit card data securely. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance user experiences through quick and reliable access to card information.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific credit card identified by its unique identifier. It provides essential data such as the cardholder's name, expiration date, and balance.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details of a specific credit card with the identifier CARD-400045. The request must be in JSON format, and it is expected to conform to the defined schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested credit card details.
